CYCLE09: SHARP COMPLETE POSITIVE-STATE KMS POWER PROFILE
Origin: foundational_transfer_sol, Sol/max; no descendants.
Date: 2026-10-09. Immutable after the first reported SHA256.
Status at origin freeze: complete internally derived proof candidate, including
the lower profile and a finite legal sharpness reduction. Fresh physical and
theorem-first adversarial audits pending. No external/formal/priority claim.
No Cycle09 sibling proof has been read. Root supplied only a transport hint and
later reported a concurrent matching spectral coefficient, not a positivity or
sharpness proof. The two-multiplier Hardy argument below is the new mechanism.

THE EXACT THEOREM CANDIDATE, IN OWN NORMALIZATION

Let sigma>0 be a finite density. Let L be a positive Heisenberg Markov
generator, exp(-tL) unital CP, with stationary sigma and KMS symmetry.
Write s=sqrt(sigma), G(X)=s^(1/2)Xs^(1/2), H=G L G^(-1), which is HS
self-adjoint. For EVERY real 1<p<infinity and EVERY positive definite f,
let q=p/(p-1), and define the positive-state power operator

 I_{q,p}(f)=sigma^(-1/(2q))
              (sigma^(1/(2p)) f sigma^(1/(2p)))^(p/q)
            sigma^(-1/(2q)),
 E_p(f)=p/[2(p-1)] Tr[s I_{q,p}(f) s L(f)],
 E_root(f)=E_2(I_{2,p}(f)).

Then the proposed SHARP universal inequality is

 E_p(f) >= c_p E_root(f),
 c_p = p sin(pi/p)/[2(p-1)].                              (T)

The identical constant holds with any finite untouched quantum reference R,
any faithful stationary reference state tau_R, stationary product tau_R tensor
sigma, and every positive definite FULL joint f on R tensor B. The reference
may be entangled after the power-to-density conversion. No local/reference
dimension bound, primitivity, GNS/modular covariance, commutation, fixed state
marginal, information bound, or uniform spectral lower bound is required.
The sharp constant is unchanged if the generator is required primitive.

At p=2, c_2=1 and the inequality is equality by definition. At p=1 the
continuous endpoint is c_1=pi/2, namely E_1=J/2>=pi E_root/2; the supplied
internally closed Checkpoint08 theorem and sharpness give that endpoint.
No infinity endpoint, all-Hermitian extension, non-KMS extension, normal
infinite-dimensional extension, or efficient sharpness acquisition is claimed.

PRIMARY SOURCE AND DEPENDENCY BOUNDARY

Propos

CYCLE09 EXPOSED ROOT LEAD: ALL-COMPLEX POLAR DILATION AUDIT

Attribution and scope
----------------------
ROOT supplied the 2x2 Hermitian dilation lead after the independent positive
and signed-Hermitian profile mechanism had been sent, but shortly before its
file freeze. It was not used in that baseline. This audit begins only AFTER
the signed baseline freeze, SHA256
3db7efb7cd8e4c8a991e56ba8c3cd4b136dcd02f5552cab38ecb370d16d3851a.
The all-complex extension is attributed to that ROOT lead; this worker
independently checks its exact weight and real-pairing factors here. No
current sibling profile proof was read. This is an exposed addendum, not a
retrospectively blind discovery.

Conclusion: PASS. For all finite1<p<infinity and every complex matrix f,
the same profile C_p=p sin(pi/p)/[2(p-1)] holds under the explicitly POLAR
weighted definitions below, assuming the frozen signed-Hermitian theorem.
Arbitrary finite references and nonprimitive local generators are included.
No p1 all-complex finite-entropy claim is made. This does not validate the
source's inconsistent absolute-power/all-Hermitian definitions or its literal
printed weak factor(p-1) for p>=2.

1. Exact polar definitions
----------------------------
Let A=Gamma_sigma^(1/p)f=U|A| be its polar decomposition and p'=p/(p-1).
Define, for a>=1,

 I_a,p^polar(f)=Gamma_sigma^(-1/a)[U|A|^(p/a)],
 E_p^polar(f)=p/[2(p-1)] Re<I_p',p^polar(f),L(f)>_sigma,
 E_2(G)=<G,L(G)>_sigma,
 <G,H>_sigma=Tr[G^*Gamma_sigma(H)].

For KMS L, the quadratic E2 is real nonnegative for every complex G. At p2
the polar map gives I2,2(f)=f. On Hermitian/positive inputs these definitions
agree with the explicitly signed/positive conventions in the frozen baseline.
Partial polar isometries at singular inputs cause no ambiguity because every
power exponent used here is positive; extend by continuity if desired.

2. Weighted dilation power transport
--------------------------------------
Use stationary Sigma=(I2/2)tensor sigma, generator Lhat=id_M2 tensor L, and

 D_f=[[0,f],[f^*,0]].

This is Hermitian. The lifted generator is KMS and has a faithful stationary
state even though it need not be primitive. For any real r,

 Gamma_Sigma^r(D_f)=2^(-r)D_(Gamma_sigma^r f).

Hence the weighted Hermitian matrix at exponent1/p is
Xhat=2^(-1/p)D_A. Since
|D_A|=diag(|A^*|,|A|), functional calculus gives, for every alpha>0,

 sgn(D_A)|D_A|^alpha
